newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian state notes raise 6.7 bln bfr on first day.
newsitem.headline: Belgian state notes raise 6.7 bln bfr on first day.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury said on Thursday it raised 6.66 billion Belgian francs on the first day of subscriptions to its latest issue of state notes.
In a statement the Treasury said subscriptions to its five-year state note, extendable to seven years, amounted to 4.35 billion francs.
For the 3/5/7 note - which bears a revisable coupon and put options at three, five and seven years and has a guaranteed minimum coupon - subscriptions amounted to 2.31 billion francs.
The notes will be issued on September 18.
The first such issue in June raised a total of 16.65 billion Belgian francs. The finance ministry said then it aimed to raise around 85 billion francs altogether through four issues in 12 months.
